question: Which of the following major health issues is Puducherry targeting in 2025 through its new screening initiative under the Family Adoption Programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuberculosis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Union Territory of **Puducherry** has integrated a specialized screening initiative for **Tuberculosis (TB)** within its **Family Adoption Programme (FAP)** to be completed by **2025**.
 
• This initiative is part of the broader **National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP)**, which aims to make **India TB-free** by the year **2025**, five years ahead of the global **Sustainable Development Goal (SDG)** target of **2030**.
 
• Under the **Family Adoption Programme**, **medical students** from various government and private medical colleges, such as the **Indira Gandhi Medical College and Research Institute (IGMCRI)**, adopt families in rural or urban-slum areas.
